sections.title: Sound of the letter
paragraphs: The letter is named (G) /g/. Its main sound is heard in the word (gas) /ɡæs/, which means fuel or vapour. This letter has four sounds in English speech.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, push the back of your tongue against the soft roof. Block the air, turn your voice on, and release. For the second, press your tongue tip behind your upper teeth and glide into a hiss. For the third, narrow that space and hiss with voice. The last sound makes no movement. Touch your throat to feel it vibrate.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: Before the letters a, o, u or consonants, say (gold) /ɡoʊld/. Often before e, i, or y, it sounds like (gem) /dʒɛm/. In French loanwords before e or i, say (regime) /reɪ.ʒim/. Before n at the start or end of a root, it is a silent letter, as in (sign) /saɪn/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn off your voice at the start of (gas) /ɡæs/. A voiceless sound is made without voice. If your throat does not shake, the word sounds wrong. Touch your throat and keep the voice buzzing from the start.
